name: skill-authoring
description: Skill authoring. Skills: skill-builder (create a skill or pack as a folder with SKILL.md, references/, and optional scripts or assets; the YAML description is a when-to-invoke trigger), skill-doctor (restructure an existing SKILL.md, agent-instruction file such as AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / similar, or a pack; meaning stays). Invoke skill-builder when creating; invoke skill-doctor when the file is too long, over-constrained, or the description is a summary.
